title: Saudi Arabian Beef Skillet
description: A flavorful and aromatic beef skillet dish inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, made with tender beef and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil and sauté the beef until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the Arabian spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-12 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
